out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the GRILL LINE being used FOR FOOD PREP.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC will only use for handwashing.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Package Integrity
violations.observation: Due to cut or damaged packaging, the following food is subject to contamination: broken boxes and unwrapped foods observed in walk in freezer
violations.corrective_action: Food containers that are received packaged together in a case or overwrap shall be protected from cuts when the case or overwrap is opened.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. Interior of ice machine was observed with accumulation of debris.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: cooked bean sprouts, cooked beef, sauces, pickled radish
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. Please date mark all prepared food items.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Observed soy sauce stored with paint in outdoor storage hallway.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. Items moved.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed food items on the floor of the walk in cooler and both walk in freezers.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Please organize freezers.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of FOOD ITEMS.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crate(s) found used for the following purpose(s): utensils and container storage
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: Prep tables, containers holding utensils, interior of units
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Premises Free of Unnecessary Items/Equipment
violations.observation: Observed that items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment are being stored on the premises. Observed unused equipment in the outdoor storage room, outdoor storage hallways, out door storage attic, and noodle cooking area, throughout kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Remove unnecessary items, including equipment which is no longer in use, from the premises to allow for regular and effective cleaning and to prevent harborage conditions. Please remove all unnecessary items from establishment.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Required
violations.observation: The food establishment's Permit to Operate is no longer valid due to expiration of the permit. No person shall operate a food establishment unless that person possesses a valid permit issued by the Health Department.
violations.corrective_action: To obtain a current Permit to Operate, contact the Health Department at (703) 246-2201 within 48 hours to make payment of the permit renewal fee. You may provide payment by cash, check, or credit card. Failure to pay the permit renewal fee and obtain a current Permit to Operate within 48 hours may lead to further enforcement actions by the Health Department including immediate closure.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink in the rear/BOH prep area being used for the storage of prep bowls.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC instructed to only use handsinks for designated hand washing only. Bowl removed to be washed, rinsed, sanitized in 3-compartment sink. SUSHI PROJECT (Inspection Date: 01/13/2026) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at handwashing sink located in the front ramen/stir fry prep area.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. Paper towels provided.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: china/ceramic plates and dishes ran through chemical dish machine dispensing 0 ppm chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC instructed to cease use of the dish machine and to utilize the 3-compartment sink for the washing, rinsing, and sanitizing of all food service utensils and equipment. The 3-compartment sink was cleaned, set-up, and dishes were placed into the 3-compartment sink to re- wash, rinse, and sanitize.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: glass noodles (107F), white rice (120F), roasted duck (85F) inside 1 do upright warming cabinet.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Glass noodles, white rice, roasted duck discarded.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: Per PIC, food that is prepared on site and stored in walk in cooler is kept for 7 days. No food prepared on site observed with date marking.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. All food in walk-in cooler was dated marked during the time of inspection.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: sushi at buffet line
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Chemical/sanitizing wipes, descaling/degreaser container observed on dry storage shelf.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. Chemical/sanitizing wipes and degreaser removed from dry storage shelf, stored away. A designated shelf for the storage of poisonous and toxic materials to be provided.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Frozen tuna, filleted fish in ROP packaging observed stored in refrigeration.
violations.corrective_action: ROP fish containers were pierced/cut by the PIC.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: frozen chicken observed thawing in standing water in bus-bin
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. PIC instructed to relocate thawing chicken to walk-in cooler or be transferred under running water of 70F or below.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food on Display, Guards/Packaging
violations.observation: The food on display in warmers in the buffer area with completely removable lids are not protected from contamination.
violations.corrective_action: Food on display shall be protected from contamination by the use of packaging, counter, service line, or salad bar food guards, display cases, or other effective means. Warmers removed from the buffet line.

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. walk in cooler(s) and walk in freezer(s) observed lined with food stored directly on the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC to obtain adequate storage/shelving units and dunnage for food in walk in cooler(s) and freezer(s) to be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.

violations.title: Food Storage No Contamination
violations.observation: Food stored in a location where it is subject to splash, dust or other contamination as follows: rear, exterior area (intended for deliveries, refuse storage) being used as dry storage for food. Whole pineapples and onions observed stored outside where they are subject to contamination, harborage conditions, and an area where there are no cleanable surfaces.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food where it is not exposed to splash, dust or other contamination. Rear exterior area to ONLY be used for refuse, recyclables, and other general uses and to *NOT* be used as a dry storage area or for storage of clean equipment, utensils, and dishes. PIC to obtain adequate storage and shelving that will be for designated dry storage only.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens, Prohibited Storage Areas
violations.observation: Clean equipment/utensils were found stored in the rear, exterior delivery/refuse area.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned and sanitized equipment, utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items may not be stored in: 1) locker rooms, 2) toilet rooms, 3) garbage rooms, 4) mechanical rooms, 5) under sewer lines that are not shielded to intercept potential drips, 6) under leaking water lines including leaking automatic fire sprinkler heads or under lines on which water has condensed, 7) under open stairwells, or 8) under other sources of contamination. All equipment and dry good items to be removed from the exterior area. PIC to obtain designated storage and shelving for the storage of clean equipment that is not in use and for dry goods storage.

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils, No Cloth Drying
violations.observation: China/ceramic dishes and plates were observed cloth-dried rather than air-dried after cleaning and chemical sanitization after being ran through malfunctioning dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils may not be cloth dried. PIC instructed to obtain adequate storage and shelving for the air-drying of clean equipment; instructed to cease cloth drying of cleaned equipment.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: chemical dispensing dish machine observed dispensing 0 ppm sanitizer
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Cease use of dish machine. A follow-up to be conduced within 10 days to verify repair and operation of the chemical dish machine.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: unfinished plywood shelf constructed underneath oven
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. Plywood shelf to be removed

violations.title: Equip/Utensils, Durable under Normal Use
violations.observation: The following equipment is not designed and constructed to be durable: (1) non-NSF/ANSI equivalent preparation tables lined with peel and stick contact paper observed in back of house sushi preparation area (2) non-NSF/ANSI equivalent “Ninja” brand, residential-use crock pots observed in buffet self service area for self service of hot foods, (3) non approved and non-NSF/ANSI equivalent water dispenser and espresso machine observed installed post- pre-occupancy inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment and utensils shall be designed and constructed to be durable and to retain their characteristic qualities under normal use conditions. All equipment to be removed.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Premises Free of Unnecessary Items/Equipment
violations.observation: Observed that items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment are being stored on the premises.
violations.corrective_action: Remove unnecessary items, including equipment which is no longer in use, from the premises to allow for regular and effective cleaning and to prevent harborage conditions. SUSHI PROJECT (Inspection Date: 01/13/2026) Page 3 of 4
